Text_en:
And there, Roland Barthes writes in a brilliant phrase:

"What time destroys is the sense of delay,
Not the voice of sadness and grief from the lost.
That's all!
I don't cry anymore…
But I insist on respecting the authenticity of my suffering"

Text_en:
Barth talks about the continuous nature of mourning and the endless terror of mourning, about the ups and downs of grief in the hearts of the survivors.

From the shame of our survival in the grief of the lost, from our daily doubts, that we are not prone to mourning and worthy of such great grief.

And one of our challenges today, which is to find the courage to continue!/6

Text_en:
"Everything has a ceiling except sadness"

He was tried for the crime of being a "parasite of society". He was a worker who did not praise the dictator in his poem.

The judge said; You are not a poet!
Joseph Brodsky said; I am not even human for you.

Hospitalized and tortured, and exiled to Siberia and...

At the age of 47, he won the Nobel Prize before his death! /1
